prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Hydrogen Nation, of the Balloon House. A female personification character with a bunch of pale hydrogen balloons on strings as her motif — the object reimagined as a woman in cloth and ornament that carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs. She does NOT hold, carry or wield the object; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Hydrogen (H) to carry in her design and the scene: airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water. Palette: pale sky blue, white, silver, a faint violet flame, clear glass.
HOUSE TRAITS of Balloon: round gas envelopes, netting and mooring ropes, a wicker or brass gondola; buoyancy shown as hair and skirts lifting upward. Palette: cream canvas, pale blue, brass, rope tan.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: petite, small-framed build; twin tails; pale pastel sky-blue hair.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): heart-shaped face; wide almond eyes; soft rounded brows; small button nose; full heart-shaped lips; sky-blue eyes.
WORLD — FANTASY: a kingdom floating above the clouds: sky islands tethered by ropes, drifting balloon-lanterns, a temple that keeps a star's pale fire, endless morning sky. COSTUME (citizen, fantasy): her object leads — its silhouette, parts and materials must read at first glance in her outfit and headpiece, the object reimagined as cloth, forged pieces and ornament; the fantasy era only sets the period cut and finish — cloth, leather, forged metal, subtle magical glow. No corset, no modern material, no machinery. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outfit opens to show skin — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or a short hem where the outfit allows; pieces stay symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the object's shape, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (H) and atomic number (1) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
